example.zh: 已经十点了，他还在工作。
example.py: Yǐjīng shí diǎn le, tā hái zài gōngzuò.
example.en: It is already ten o'clock, but he is still working.

还.meaning: to return, to give back, to repay

example.zh: 我从图书馆借了一本书，明天要去还书。
example.py: Wǒ cóng túshūguǎn jiè le yì běn shū, míngtiān yào qù huán shū.
example.en: I borrowed a book from the library and need to return it tomorrow.

example.zh: 你好，很高兴认识你！
example.py: Nǐ hǎo, hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ!
example.en: Hello, nice to meet you!

好.meaning: to like, to be fond of, to love

example.zh: 他从小就特别好学，每天都会读很多书。
example.py: Tā cóngxiǎo jiù tèbié hàoxué, měitiān dōu huì dú hěnduō shū.
example.en: He has been very fond of learning since childhood and reads many books every day.

看.meaning: to see, to look at, to read, to watch

example.zh: 我喜欢在家里看书。
example.py: Wǒ xǐhuan zài jiālǐ kàn shū.
example.en: I like reading books at home.

看.meaning: to look after, to watch over, to guard

example.zh: 农场里养了一只忠诚的大狗帮主人看门。
example.py: Nóngchǎng lǐ yǎng le yì zhī zhōngchéng de dà gǒu bāng zhǔrén kān mén.
example.en: A loyal big dog was raised on the farm to help the owner guard the gate.

只.meaning: measure word for animals, birds, or one of a pair

example.zh: 树上有一只小鸟。
example.py: Shù shàng yǒu yì zhī xiǎoniǎo.
example.en: There is a little bird in the tree.

example.zh: 我只有一个哥哥，没有姐姐。
example.py: Wǒ zhǐ yǒu yí gè gēge, méiyǒu jiějie.
example.en: I only have one older brother; I do not have an older sister.

啊.meaning: modal particle at sentence end expressing enthusiasm or agreement

example.zh: 好啊，我们明天下午一起去吧！
example.py: Hǎo a, wǒmen míngtiān xiàwǔ yìqǐ qù ba!
example.en: Great, let's go together tomorrow afternoon!

啊.meaning: interjection expressing surprise, admiration, or realization

example.zh: 啊，这里的风景真是太美丽了！
example.py: Ā, zhèlǐ de fēngjǐng zhēn shì tài měilì le!
example.en: Ah, the scenery here is truly breathtaking!

example.zh: 这条路很长，我们坐出租车去吧。
example.py: Zhè tiáo lù hěn cháng, wǒmen zuò chūzūchē qù ba.
example.en: This road is very long; let's go by taxi.

example.zh: 一年没见，小男孩长高了不少。
example.py: Yì nián méi jiàn, xiǎo nánhái zhǎng gāo le bù shǎo.
example.en: Having not seen him for a year, the little boy has grown quite a bit taller.

地.meaning: structural particle connecting adverb/adjective to verb

example.zh: 妹妹高兴地笑了。
example.py: Mèimei gāoxìng de xiào le.
example.en: Younger sister smiled happily.

example.zh: 地上有很多水，走路请小心。
example.py: Dì shàng yǒu hěnduō shuǐ, zǒulù qǐng xiǎoxīn.
example.en: There is a lot of water on the ground; please be careful walking.

得.meaning: particle connecting verb to complement of manner/degree

example.zh: 他说汉语说得很好。
example.py: Tā shuō hànyǔ shuō de hěn hǎo.
example.en: He speaks Chinese very well.

得.meaning: to get, to obtain, to acquire, to win

example.zh: 他在这次汉语比赛中得了第一名。
example.py: Tā zài zhè cì hànyǔ bǐsài zhōng dé le dì-yī míng.
example.en: He won first place in this Chinese competition.

example.zh: 时间不早了，我得回家了。
example.py: Shíjiān bù zǎo le, wǒ děi huí jiā le.
example.en: It is getting late; I must go home.

过.meaning: to pass, cross; to celebrate, spend (time)

example.zh: 过马路的时候要看车，注意安全。
example.py: Guò mǎlù de shíhou yào kàn chē, zhùyì ānquán.
example.en: When crossing the street, watch for cars and pay attention to safety.

过.meaning: experiential aspect particle indicating past experience

example.zh: 我去过中国，吃过北京烤鸭。
example.py: Wǒ qùguo Zhōngguó, chīguo Běijīng kǎoyā.
example.en: I have been to China and eaten Peking duck.

头.meaning: head; chief; measure word for cattle or pigs

example.zh: 他感冒了，今天头有点儿疼。
example.py: Tā gǎnmào le, jīntiān tóu yǒudiǎnr téng.
example.en: He caught a cold and has a slight headache today.

头.meaning: noun suffix forming everyday objects (e.g. 石头, 木头)

example.zh: 小溪边有很多被水冲得光滑的石头。
example.py: Xiǎoxī biān yǒu hěnduō bèi shuǐ chōng de guānghuá de shítou.
example.en: By the stream are many stones smoothed by the flowing water.

着.meaning: aspect particle indicating ongoing state or action

example.zh: 门开着，请进吧。
example.py: Mén kāi zhe, qǐng jìn ba.
example.en: The door is open; please come in.

着.meaning: to catch (fire); to fall asleep; to feel anxious

example.zh: 昨天晚上我喝了咖啡，很晚才睡着。
example.py: Zuótiān wǎnshang wǒ hē le kāfēi, hěn wǎn cái shuìzháo.
example.en: I drank coffee last night and fell asleep very late.

example.zh: 这个地方很漂亮，我想再去一次。
example.py: Zhège dìfang hěn piàoliang, wǒ xiǎng zài qù yí cì.
example.en: This place is very beautiful; I want to go again.

地方.meaning: local, regional (as opposed to central); locality

example.zh: 我们要充分尊重各个地方的风俗和文化特色。
example.py: Wǒmen yào chōngfèn zūnzhòng gègè dìfāng de fēngsú hé wénhuà tèsè.
example.en: We should fully respect the customs and cultural characteristics of each locality.

干.meaning: to do, to work, to manage

example.zh: 周末你在家里干什么呢？
example.py: Zhōumò nǐ zài jiālǐ gàn shénme ne?
example.en: What are you doing at home over the weekend?

example.zh: 晒了一整天太阳，洗好的衣服已经干了。
example.py: Shài le yì zhěng tiān tàiyáng, xǐ hǎo de yīfu yǐjīng gān le.
example.en: After hanging in the sun all day, the washed clothes are dry.

为.meaning: for, for the sake of; because of

example.zh: 爸爸每天努力工作，为了让我们生活得更好。
example.py: Bàba měitiān nǔlì gōngzuò, wèile ràng wǒmen shēnghuó de gèng hǎo.
example.en: Dad works hard every day to make our lives better.

为.meaning: to act as, to serve as; to become; to do

example.zh: 作为一名学生，我们应该努力学习。
example.py: Zuòwéi yìmíng xuésheng, wǒmen yīnggāi nǔlì xuéxí.
example.en: As a student, we should study hard.

行.meaning: to go, walk, travel; okay, capable

example.zh: 我们明天下午三点见面，行吗？
example.py: Wǒmen míngtiān xiàwǔ sān diǎn jiànmiàn, xíng ma?
example.en: We meet tomorrow afternoon at three o'clock, is that okay?

example.zh: 他在一家商业银行工作，这个行业的薪酬待遇很好。
example.py: Tā zài yì jiā shāngyè yínháng gōngzuò, zhège hángyè de xīnchóu dàiyù hěn hǎo.
example.en: He works at a commercial bank, and compensation in this industry is very good.

example.zh: 我们中间有三个人是老师。
example.py: Wǒmen zhōngjiān yǒu sān gè rén shì lǎoshī.
example.en: Among us, three people are teachers.

中.meaning: to hit (a target), to win (a prize), to suffer

example.zh: 这支箭正好中了靶心，赢得了全场掌声。
example.py: Zhè zhī jiàn zhènghǎo zhòng le bǎxīn, yíngdé le quánchǎng zhǎngshēng.
example.en: This arrow hit the bullseye exactly, winning applause from the whole audience.

example.zh: 这家超市里有许多种新鲜的水果。
example.py: Zhè jiā chāoshì lǐ yǒu xǔduō zhǒng xīnxiān de shuǐguǒ.
example.en: There are many kinds of fresh fruit in this supermarket.

example.zh: 爷爷在院子里种了很多漂亮的花。
example.py: Yéye zài yuànzi lǐ zhòng le hěnduō piàoliang de huā.
example.en: Grandpa planted many beautiful flowers in the yard.

背.meaning: to carry on the back or shoulder

example.zh: 小学生们每天早上背着书包高高兴兴去上学。
example.py: Xiǎoxuéshēngmen měitiān zǎoshang bēi zhe shūbāo gāogāoxìngxìng qù shàngxué.
example.en: The primary school students happily go to school every morning carrying their backpacks.

背.meaning: back (of body); to recite from memory; out of luck

example.zh: 他每天清晨都在公园里背诵经典的中文诗篇。
example.py: Tā měitiān qīngchén dōu zài gōngyuán lǐ bèisòng jīngdiǎn de zhōngwén shīpiān.
example.en: Every early morning he recites classic Chinese poems from memory in the park.

example.zh: 老师让我们把这篇作业重新做一遍。
example.py: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen bǎ zhè piān zuòyè chóngxīn zuò yí biàn.
example.en: The teacher asked us to do this homework assignment once again.

example.zh: 这个行李箱太重了，我一个人根本搬不动。
example.py: Zhège xínglixiāng tài zhòng le, wǒ yí gè rén gēnběn bān bu dòng.
example.en: This suitcase is too heavy; I simply cannot carry it on my own.

example.zh: 放假期间他在家里安静地待了一整周。
example.py: Fàngjià qījiān tā zài jiālǐ ānjìng de dāi le yì zhěng zhōu.
example.en: During the vacation, he stayed quietly at home for an entire week.

待.meaning: to treat, receive; to wait for, await

example.zh: 面对远道而来的客人，他们热情地接待了大家。
example.py: Miànduì yuǎndào'érlái de kèrén, tāmen rèqíng de jiēdài le dàjiā.
example.en: Facing guests who came from afar, they received everyone warmly.

当.meaning: to serve as, to act as, to be; at (that time/place)

example.zh: 长大后当一名优秀的医生是她的理想。
example.py: Zhǎngdà hòu dāng yìmíng yōuxiù de yīshēng shì tā de lǐxiǎng.
example.en: Her dream is to be an excellent doctor when she grows up.

当.meaning: to treat as, to regard as; appropriate; to be fooled

example.zh: 我一直把他当成我最值得信赖的好朋友。
example.py: Wǒ yìzhí bǎ tā dàngchéng wǒ zuì zhídé xìnlài de hǎo péngyou.
example.en: I have always regarded him as my most trustworthy good friend.

倒.meaning: to pour; reverse, upside down, backwards

example.zh: 他把温水倒进了玻璃杯里。
example.py: Tā bǎ wēnshuǐ dào jìn le bōlibēi lǐ.
example.en: He poured the warm water into the glass.

倒.meaning: to fall down, to collapse, to topple

example.zh: 外面刮起大风，路边的一棵大树倒了。
example.py: Wàimiàn guā qǐ dàfēng, lùbiān de yì kē dàshù dǎo le.
example.en: A strong wind blew outside, and a big tree by the road fell down.

空.meaning: empty, hollow; sky, air; in vain

example.zh: 今天天气很好，蓝蓝的天空上没有一朵云。
example.py: Jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, lánlán de tiānkōng shàng méiyǒu yì duǒ yún.
example.en: The weather is great today; there is not a single cloud in the blue sky.

空.meaning: free time, leisure; blank space, leave empty

example.zh: 你明天下午有空吗？我们一起去参观博物馆吧。
example.py: Nǐ míngtiān xiàwǔ yǒu kòng ma? Wǒmen yìqǐ qù cānguān bówùguǎn ba.
example.en: Do you have free time tomorrow afternoon? Let's go visit the museum together.

example.zh: 医生给病人量了体温，发现他发烧了。
example.py: Yīshēng gěi bìngrén liáng le tǐwēn, fāxiàn tā fāshāo le.
example.en: The doctor measured the patient's temperature and found that he had a fever.

example.zh: 每天保证充足的饮水量对身体健康非常重要。
example.py: Měitiān bǎozhèng chōngzú de yǐnshuǐ liàng duì shēntǐ jiànkāng fēicháng zhòngyào.
example.en: Ensuring an adequate amount of water intake every day is very important for health.

落.meaning: to fall, to drop, to land; to decline

example.zh: 秋天到了，树叶慢慢地落了下来。
example.py: Qiūtiān dào le, shùyè mànman de luò le xiàlai.
example.en: Autumn has arrived, and leaves slowly fell down.

example.zh: 他早上出门太匆忙，把家门钥匙落在办公室里了。
example.py: Tā zǎoshang chūmén tài cōngmáng, bǎ jiāmén yàoshi là zài bàngōngshì lǐ le.
example.en: He left in too much of a hurry this morning and left his house keys in the office.

example.zh: 他的数学成绩非常好，经常考一百分。
example.py: Tā de shùxué chéngjì fēicháng hǎo, jīngcháng kǎo yībǎi fēn.
example.en: His math grades are very good; he often scores 100 points.

example.zh: 小女孩坐在院子里的台阶上，认真地数着天上的星星。
example.py: Xiǎo nǚhái zuò zài yuànzi lǐ de táijiē shàng, rènzhēn de shǔ zhe tiān shàng de xīngxing.
example.en: The little girl sat on the courtyard steps, carefully counting the stars in the sky.

转.meaning: to turn, shift direction, transfer, change

example.zh: 穿过这条马路，在前面的十字路口向左转。
example.py: Chuānguò zhè tiáo mǎlù, zài qiánmiàn de shízìlùkǒu xiàng zuǒ zhuǎn.
example.en: Cross this street and turn left at the intersection ahead.

转.meaning: to spin, rotate, revolve, turn around

example.zh: 风扇一直在快速转动，房间里渐渐凉快了起来。
example.py: Fēngshàn yìzhí zài kuàisù zhuàndòng, fángjiān lǐ jiànjiàn liángkuai le qǐlai.
example.en: The fan kept spinning rapidly, and the room gradually cooled down.

冲.meaning: to rush, to rinse; to brew (with boiling water)

example.zh: 请用热水冲一杯热茶。
example.py: Qǐng yòng rèshuǐ chōng yì bēi rèchá.
example.en: Please brew a cup of hot tea with hot water.

example.zh: 他冲我笑了笑，似乎是在暗示会议已经结束。
example.py: Tā chòng wǒ xiào le xiào, sìhū shì zài ànshì huìyì yǐjīng jiéshù.
example.en: He smiled towards me, as if hinting that the meeting was already over.

处.meaning: to get along with; to deal with, handle; to reside

example.zh: 他们俩性格相投，平时相处得非常融洽。
example.py: Tāmen liǎ xìnggé xiāngtóu, píngshí xiāngchǔ de fēicháng róngqià.
example.en: The two have compatible personalities and get along very well.

example.zh: 春天来了，公园里到处都是盛开的鲜花。
example.py: Chūntiān lái le, gōngyuán lǐ dàochù dōu shì shèngkāi de xiānhuā.
example.en: Spring is here, and blooming flowers are everywhere in the park.

调.meaning: to transfer, shift; tune, tone, melody; investigate

example.zh: 有关部门正在对这起意外事件展开详细调查。
example.py: Yǒuguān bùmén zhèngzài duì zhè qǐ yìwài shìjiàn zhǎnkāi xiángxì diàochá.
example.en: Relevant departments are conducting a detailed investigation into this unexpected incident.

example.zh: 会议室里有点儿冷，请把空调的温度调高一点。
example.py: Huìyìshì lǐ yǒudiǎnr lěng, qǐng bǎ kōngtiáo de wēndù tiáo gāo yìdiǎn.
example.en: It's a little chilly in the meeting room; please turn the air conditioner's temperature up a bit.

划.meaning: to row, to paddle; to scratch; worthwhile

example.zh: 周末天气晴朗，我们去公园湖上划船。
example.py: Zhōumò tiānqì qínglǎng, wǒmen qù gōngyuán hú shàng huáchuán.
example.en: The weather was sunny over the weekend, so we went boating on the park lake.

划.meaning: to plan; to delimit, divide, draw a line

example.zh: 他在地图上划出了一条最短的路线。
example.py: Tā zài dìtú shàng huàchū le yì tiáo zuì duǎn de lùxiàn.
example.en: He drew the shortest route on the map.

系.meaning: to tie, to fasten, to buckle

example.zh: 上车之后请大家务必系好安全带。
example.py: Shàng chē zhīhòu qǐng dàjiā wùbì jì hǎo ānquándài.
example.en: Please be sure to fasten your seatbelt after getting in the car.

example.zh: 技术团队成功地把两个数据库系统连接了起来。
example.py: Jìshù tuánduì chénggōng de bǎ liǎng gè shùjùkù xìtǒng liánjiē le qǐlai.
example.en: The technical team successfully connected the two database systems.

结.meaning: to knot, tie; result, conclude, finish

example.zh: 经过几个小时的热烈讨论，会议终于圆满结束了。
example.py: Jīngguò jǐ gè xiǎoshí de rèliè tǎolùn, huìyì zhōngyú yuánmǎn jiéshù le.
example.en: After several hours of lively discussion, the meeting finally concluded successfully.

example.zh: 这棵苹果树去年没有开花，今年却结了不少红苹果。
example.py: Zhè kē píngguǒ shù qùnián méiyǒu kāihuā, jīnnián què jiē le bù shǎo hóng píngguǒ.
example.en: This apple tree did not blossom last year, but this year it has borne quite a lot of red apples.

example.zh: 天气炎热，她拿起扇子给自己扇了扇风。
example.py: Tiānqì yánrè, tā ná qǐ shànzi gěi zìjǐ shān le shān fēng.
example.en: The weather was scorching, so she picked up a fan to fan herself.

扇.meaning: fan (noun); measure word for doors or windows

example.zh: 这扇大窗户朝南，清晨阳光能直接照进房间。
example.py: Zhè shàn dà chuānghu cháo nán, qīngchén yángguāng néng zhíjiē zhào jìn fángjiān.
example.en: This large window faces south, so the morning sun can shine directly into the room.

example.zh: 厨师把切好的土豆条放进热油锅里炸成金黄色。
example.py: Chúshī bǎ qiè hǎo de tǔdòutiáo fàng jìn rè yóuguō lǐ zhá chéng jīnhuángsè.
example.en: The chef put the cut potato strips into hot oil to fry them until golden brown.

炸.meaning: to explode, to burst, to bomb

example.zh: 突然传来的巨响，让大家以为附近有东西爆炸了。
example.py: Tūrán chuán lái de jùxiǎng, ràng dàjiā yǐwéi fùjìn yǒu dōngxi bàozhà le.
example.en: The sudden loud noise made everyone think something nearby had exploded.

卷.meaning: to roll, to curl; roll; measure word for rolls

example.zh: 她把海报卷起来，放进纸筒里带走。
example.py: Tā bǎ hǎibào juǎn qǐlai, fàng jìn zhǐtǒng lǐ dàizǒu.
example.en: She rolled up the poster and put it into a paper tube to take away.

example.zh: 这套小说一共有三卷，内容围绕同一个家族展开。
example.py: Zhè tào xiǎoshuō yígòng yǒu sān juàn, nèiróng wéirào tóng yí gè jiāzú zhǎnkāi.
example.en: This set of novels has three volumes in total, revolving around the same family.

example.zh: 书桌的抽屉里放着一些零散的硬币和回形针。
example.py: Shūzhuō de chōuti lǐ fàng zhe yìxiē língsǎn de yìngbì hé huíxíngzhēn.
example.en: There are some loose coins and paperclips in the desk drawer.

散.meaning: to scatter, to disperse, break up; to take a walk

example.zh: 会议结束后，人群很快散开，各自回到了办公室。
example.py: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, rénqún hěn kuài sànkāi, gèzì huídào le bàngōngshì.
example.en: After the meeting ended, the crowd quickly dispersed and returned to their offices.

example.zh: 在公共场所随地吐口水既不卫生，也很不礼貌。
example.py: Zài gōnggòng chǎngsuǒ suídì tǔ kǒushuǐ jì bù wèishēng, yě hěn bù lǐmào.
example.en: Spitting in public places is both unhygienic and very impolite.

example.zh: 他晕车很严重，刚下车就吐了。
example.py: Tā yùnchē hěn yánzhòng, gāng xià chē jiù tù le.
example.en: He had bad motion sickness and vomited as soon as he got off the car.

看.meaning: to see, to look at, to read, to watch

example.zh: 我喜欢在家里看书。
example.py: Wǒ xǐhuan zài jiālǐ kàn shū.
example.en: I like reading books at home.

看.meaning: to look after, to watch over, to guard

example.zh: 农场里养了一只忠诚的大狗帮主人看门。
example.py: Nóngchǎng lǐ yǎng le yì zhī zhōngchéng de dà gǒu bāng zhǔrén kān mén.
example.en: A loyal big dog was raised on the farm to help the owner guard the gate.

example.zh: 这条路很长，我们坐出租车去吧。
example.py: Zhè tiáo lù hěn cháng, wǒmen zuò chūzūchē qù ba.
example.en: This road is very long; let's go by taxi.

example.zh: 一年没见，小男孩长高了不少。
example.py: Yì nián méi jiàn, xiǎo nánhái zhǎng gāo le bù shǎo.
example.en: Having not seen him for a year, the little boy has grown quite a bit taller.

地.meaning: structural particle connecting adverb/adjective to verb

example.zh: 妹妹高兴地笑了。
example.py: Mèimei gāoxìng de xiào le.
example.en: Younger sister smiled happily.

example.zh: 地上有很多水，走路请小心。
example.py: Dì shàng yǒu hěnduō shuǐ, zǒulù qǐng xiǎoxīn.
example.en: There is a lot of water on the ground; please be careful walking.

得.meaning: particle connecting verb to complement of manner/degree

example.zh: 他说汉语说得很好。
example.py: Tā shuō hànyǔ shuō de hěn hǎo.
example.en: He speaks Chinese very well.

得.meaning: to get, to obtain, to acquire, to win

example.zh: 他在这次汉语比赛中得了第一名。
example.py: Tā zài zhè cì hànyǔ bǐsài zhōng dé le dì-yī míng.
example.en: He won first place in this Chinese competition.

example.zh: 时间不早了，我得回家了。
example.py: Shíjiān bù zǎo le, wǒ děi huí jiā le.
example.en: It is getting late; I must go home.

过.meaning: to pass, cross; to celebrate, spend (time)

example.zh: 过马路的时候要看车，注意安全。
example.py: Guò mǎlù de shíhou yào kàn chē, zhùyì ānquán.
example.en: When crossing the street, watch for cars and pay attention to safety.

过.meaning: experiential aspect particle indicating past experience

example.zh: 我去过中国，吃过北京烤鸭。
example.py: Wǒ qùguo Zhōngguó, chīguo Běijīng kǎoyā.
example.en: I have been to China and eaten Peking duck.

example.zh: 已经十点了，他还在工作。
example.py: Yǐjīng shí diǎn le, tā hái zài gōngzuò.
example.en: It is already ten o'clock, but he is still working.

还.meaning: to return, to give back, to repay

example.zh: 我从图书馆借了一本书，明天要去还书。
example.py: Wǒ cóng túshūguǎn jiè le yì běn shū, míngtiān yào qù huán shū.
example.en: I borrowed a book from the library and need to return it tomorrow.

只.meaning: measure word for animals, birds, or one of a pair

example.zh: 树上有一只小鸟。
example.py: Shù shàng yǒu yì zhī xiǎoniǎo.
example.en: There is a little bird in the tree.

example.zh: 我只有一个哥哥，没有姐姐。
example.py: Wǒ zhǐ yǒu yí gè gēge, méiyǒu jiějie.
example.en: I only have one older brother; I do not have an older sister.

行.meaning: to go, walk, travel; okay, capable

example.zh: 我们明天下午三点见面，行吗？
example.py: Wǒmen míngtiān xiàwǔ sān diǎn jiànmiàn, xíng ma?
example.en: We meet tomorrow afternoon at three o'clock, is that okay?

example.zh: 他在一家商业银行工作，这个行业的薪酬待遇很好。
example.py: Tā zài yì jiā shāngyè yínháng gōngzuò, zhège hángyè de xīnchóu dàiyù hěn hǎo.
example.en: He works at a commercial bank, and compensation in this industry is very good.

当.meaning: to serve as, to act as, to be; at (that time/place)

example.zh: 长大后当一名优秀的医生是她的理想。
example.py: Zhǎngdà hòu dāng yìmíng yōuxiù de yīshēng shì tā de lǐxiǎng.
example.en: Her dream is to be an excellent doctor when she grows up.

当.meaning: to treat as, to regard as; appropriate; to be fooled

example.zh: 我一直把他当成我最值得信赖的好朋友。
example.py: Wǒ yìzhí bǎ tā dàngchéng wǒ zuì zhídé xìnlài de hǎo péngyou.
example.en: I have always regarded him as my most trustworthy good friend.

倒.meaning: to pour; reverse, upside down, backwards

example.zh: 他把温水倒进了玻璃杯里。
example.py: Tā bǎ wēnshuǐ dào jìn le bōlibēi lǐ.
example.en: He poured the warm water into the glass.

倒.meaning: to fall down, to collapse, to topple

example.zh: 外面刮起大风，路边的一棵大树倒了。
example.py: Wàimiàn guā qǐ dàfēng, lùbiān de yì kē dàshù dǎo le.
example.en: A strong wind blew outside, and a big tree by the road fell down.

空.meaning: empty, hollow; sky, air; in vain

example.zh: 今天天气很好，蓝蓝的天空上没有一朵云。
example.py: Jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, lánlán de tiānkōng shàng méiyǒu yì duǒ yún.
example.en: The weather is great today; there is not a single cloud in the blue sky.

空.meaning: free time, leisure; blank space, leave empty

example.zh: 你明天下午有空吗？我们一起去参观博物馆吧。
example.py: Nǐ míngtiān xiàwǔ yǒu kòng ma? Wǒmen yìqǐ qù cānguān bówùguǎn ba.
example.en: Do you have free time tomorrow afternoon? Let's go visit the museum together.

example.zh: 医生给病人量了体温，发现他发烧了。
example.py: Yīshēng gěi bìngrén liáng le tǐwēn, fāxiàn tā fāshāo le.
example.en: The doctor measured the patient's temperature and found that he had a fever.

example.zh: 每天保证充足的饮水量对身体健康非常重要。
example.py: Měitiān bǎozhèng chōngzú de yǐnshuǐ liàng duì shēntǐ jiànkāng fēicháng zhòngyào.
example.en: Ensuring an adequate amount of water intake every day is very important for health.

example.zh: 他的数学成绩非常好，经常考一百分。
example.py: Tā de shùxué chéngjì fēicháng hǎo, jīngcháng kǎo yībǎi fēn.
example.en: His math grades are very good; he often scores 100 points.

example.zh: 小女孩坐在院子里的台阶上，认真地数着天上的星星。
example.py: Xiǎo nǚhái zuò zài yuànzi lǐ de táijiē shàng, rènzhēn de shǔ zhe tiān shàng de xīngxing.
example.en: The little girl sat on the courtyard steps, carefully counting the stars in the sky.

example.zh: 这个行李箱太重了，我一个人根本搬不动。
example.py: Zhège xínglixiāng tài zhòng le, wǒ yí gè rén gēnběn bān bu dòng.
example.en: This suitcase is too heavy; I simply cannot carry it on my own.

example.zh: 老师让我们把这篇作业重新做一遍。
example.py: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen bǎ zhè piān zuòyè chóngxīn zuò yí biàn.
example.en: The teacher asked us to do this homework assignment once again.

转.meaning: to turn, shift direction, transfer, change

example.zh: 穿过这条马路，在前面的十字路口向左转。
example.py: Chuānguò zhè tiáo mǎlù, zài qiánmiàn de shízìlùkǒu xiàng zuǒ zhuǎn.
example.en: Cross this street and turn left at the intersection ahead.

转.meaning: to spin, rotate, revolve, turn around

example.zh: 风扇一直在快速转动，房间里渐渐凉快了起来。
example.py: Fēngshàn yìzhí zài kuàisù zhuàndòng, fángjiān lǐ jiànjiàn liángkuai le qǐlai.
example.en: The fan kept spinning rapidly, and the room gradually cooled down.

example.zh: 春天来了，公园里到处都是盛开的鲜花。
example.py: Chūntiān lái le, gōngyuán lǐ dàochù dōu shì shèngkāi de xiānhuā.
example.en: Spring is here, and blooming flowers are everywhere in the park.

处.meaning: to get along with; to deal with, handle; to reside

example.zh: 他们俩性格相投，平时相处得非常融洽。
example.py: Tāmen liǎ xìnggé xiāngtóu, píngshí xiāngchǔ de fēicháng róngqià.
example.en: The two have compatible personalities and get along very well.

调.meaning: to transfer, shift; tune, tone, melody; investigate

example.zh: 有关部门正在对这起意外事件展开详细调查。
example.py: Yǒuguān bùmén zhèngzài duì zhè qǐ yìwài shìjiàn zhǎnkāi xiángxì diàochá.
example.en: Relevant departments are conducting a detailed investigation into this unexpected incident.

example.zh: 会议室里有点儿冷，请把空调的温度调高一点。
example.py: Huìyìshì lǐ yǒudiǎnr lěng, qǐng bǎ kōngtiáo de wēndù tiáo gāo yìdiǎn.
example.en: It's a little chilly in the meeting room; please turn the air conditioner's temperature up a bit.

系.meaning: to tie, to fasten, to buckle

example.zh: 上车之后请大家务必系好安全带。
example.py: Shàng chē zhīhòu qǐng dàjiā wùbì jì hǎo ānquándài.
example.en: Please be sure to fasten your seatbelt after getting in the car.

example.zh: 技术团队成功地把两个数据库系统连接了起来。
example.py: Jìshù tuánduì chénggōng de bǎ liǎng gè shùjùkù xìtǒng liánjiē le qǐlai.
example.en: The technical team successfully connected the two database systems.

卷.meaning: to roll, to curl; roll; measure word for rolls

example.zh: 她把海报卷起来，放进纸筒里带走。
example.py: Tā bǎ hǎibào juǎn qǐlai, fàng jìn zhǐtǒng lǐ dàizǒu.
example.en: She rolled up the poster and put it into a paper tube to take away.

example.zh: 这套小说一共有三卷，内容围绕同一个家族展开。
example.py: Zhè tào xiǎoshuō yígòng yǒu sān juàn, nèiróng wéirào tóng yí gè jiāzú zhǎnkāi.
example.en: This set of novels has three volumes in total, revolving around the same family.

example.zh: 在公共场所随地吐口水既不卫生，也很不礼貌。
example.py: Zài gōnggòng chǎngsuǒ suídì tǔ kǒushuǐ jì bù wèishēng, yě hěn bù lǐmào.
example.en: Spitting in public places is both unhygienic and very impolite.

example.zh: 他晕车很严重，刚下车就吐了。
example.py: Tā yùnchē hěn yánzhòng, gāng xià chē jiù tù le.
example.en: He had bad motion sickness and vomited as soon as he got off the car.

example.zh: 书桌的抽屉里放着一些零散的硬币和回形针。
example.py: Shūzhuō de chōuti lǐ fàng zhe yìxiē língsǎn de yìngbì hé huíxíngzhēn.
example.en: There are some loose coins and paperclips in the desk drawer.

散.meaning: to scatter, to disperse, break up; to take a walk

example.zh: 会议结束后，人群很快散开，各自回到了办公室。
example.py: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, rénqún hěn kuài sànkāi, gèzì huídào le bàngōngshì.
example.en: After the meeting ended, the crowd quickly dispersed and returned to their offices.
